title: Suggested rebooking slot after a client cancels a walk (synthetic)

hypothesis.statement: Because walkers told us rebooking after a cancellation takes several messages (DWS-EV-002), we believe offering the client one suggested replacement slot will help more cancelled walks get rebooked.
hypothesis.prediction: The share of cancelled walks rebooked within 48 hours increases from 30% to at least 35%.

primary_metric.name: rebooked_within_48h
primary_metric.definition: Cancelled walks with a replacement walk booked for the same client within 48 hours / all client-cancelled walks in the experiment window

randomisation_unit: walker account (all of a walker's clients see the same variant)
stopping_rule: Run for the full 28 days or until 1,400 cancellations per arm, whichever is later; stop early only if a guardrail is breached.

ethics.consent_note: Covered by the product terms for service improvements; walkers can opt out of experiments in settings; no change to prices or walk availability.
ethics.harm_review: Suggestion text reviewed so clients are never pressured to rebook.

decision_rule.ship_if: Two-sided p < 0.05, CI lower bound > 0 and no guardrail breached
decision_rule.do_not_ship_if: Any guardrail breached, or CI upper bound < +0.02 absolute
